pages.https://www.voxhairdressing.com/about: Boutique Hair Salon in the Heart of the Northern Quarter TRAINING ACADEMY BOOKINGSGIFT VOUCHERSSALON GALLERYABOUT USPRICESCONTACT USBOOKING INFO10% OFF FOR NEW CLIENTS About us At Vox Hairdressing, we’re a team of experienced hairdressers based in Manchester’s Northern Quarter, specialising in precision cutting, bespoke colour, and low-maintenance blonding techniques such as balayage and highlights. Our focus is on creating natural, wearable hair that works with your lifestyle and feels effortless day to day. Every appointment begins with a detailed consultation, allowing us to understand your hair, your routine, and what you want to achieve. From subtle colour refreshes to full transformations, our approach is always tailored, ensuring results that feel considered, modern, and completely personal. Our salon has recently been completely reimagined to elevate the experience for both our clients and our team. Rather than a simple update, we stripped the space back and rebuilt it with intention — carefully considering everything from lighting and layout to the overall flow of the salon. Each workstation has been bespoke and handmade, alongside thoughtfully designed refreshment areas, creating a space that feels calm, welcoming, and quietly luxurious. We exclusively use Kevin Murphy colour and styling products, chosen for both their performance and their ethos. Known for their high-quality, environmentally conscious formulations, all products are sulphate-free, paraben-free, cruelty-free, and PETA approved. Their colour range is also free from ammonia and PPDs, allowing us to deliver beautiful results while being mindful of both hair health and the environment.
